notes.title: From sketch to Scratch
notes.content:
[p][b]Hey there, cool cats and fellow flat ponies![/b][/p][p]We’re back from summer break - and still buzzing with joy from the amazing response to the [i]Scratch The Cat [/i]announcement trailer at The Six One Indie Showcase. Thanks for all the love, feedback, and purrs of excitement![/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45629709/4a51e2b6eff3adc5659ac697c21012580bfde5a9.png"][/img][/p][p]Even though the announcement trailer has dropped, that doesn’t mean the workload has - there’s still a ways to go before the final game is ready for a spin![/p][p][/p][p][b]Behind the Scratch: A Quick Look Back
[/b]As our Creative Director, Felix Sherar, revealed in an interview with [url="https://www.sixoneindie.com/read/interview-with-the-developer-of-scratch-the-cat"][u]Six One Indie[/u][/url], he originally created the game as a student project while studying sound design. That’s when the idea of a musical world was born.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45629709/af2eae5979ca9a110a20b396fb89807484897b44.png"][/img][/p][p]When Felix joined FlatPonies, he pitched the idea to our boss, Julie Heyde. She loved it and gave it the green light. In the beginning, it was just Felix and our Art Director, Christian Weatherley, working on it in between development on other games.[/p][p]This August marks the two-year anniversary of the game entering full production with the entire company. As Felix puts it:[/p][p][i]“The team itself has grown quite a bit over the last few years. We’re relatively young, but we’re part of the generation that grew up in the golden age of platformers—so it felt like a perfect fit for us.”[/i][/p][p]The game’s scale and scope have changed throughout the years, but the core goals remain the same: focusing on tight platforming and bringing 90s nostalgia to the forefront.[/p][p][i]“A big milestone was our vertical slice demo from spring 2024. We learned a lot from that - both what worked, and what didn’t.”[/i][/p][p][/p][p][b]What’s Next?
[/b]Right now, we’re making new levels and bosses, polishing animations, and bringing cutscenes to life.[/p][p]Come along for the ride - follow us on socials, and throw your questions our way.[/p][p][/p][p][b]Thanks for listening - and remember:
[/b]✨ Stay groovy. Stay scratchy. ✨[/p][p]With excitement and puuurfect hair,[/p][p]FlatPonies[/p][p][/p][p]Follow us on Social Media: [url="https://www.discord.gg/X7jwRH9KmK"]Discord [/url] - [url="https://cutt.ly/flatponiesnewsletter"]Newsletter[/url] - [url="https://bsky.app/profile/flatponies.bsky.social"]Bluesky[/url] - [url="https://tiktok.com/@flatponies"]TikTok[/url] - [url="https://www.linkedin.com/company/flatponies/"]LinkedIn[/url] - [url="https://twitter.com/FlatPonies"]X[/url] - [url="https://www.youtube.com/channel/UCpDcchIDzpDag3FpxB8TJyw"]YouTube[/url] - [url="https://www.instagram.com/flatponies/"]Instagram[/url] - [url="https://www.facebook.com/FlatPonies/"]Facebook[/url] - [url="https://www.twitch.tv/flatponies"]Twitch[/url] - [url="https://www.threads.com/@flatponies"]Threads[/url][/p]

notes.title: 🐱Scratch The Cat is Dropping the Beat – and its Announcement Trailer!
notes.content:
We’re FlatPonies — a passionate indie team straight from the barn in Copenhagen - and we’re thrilled to drop the record needle on our upcoming game: Scratch The Cat! We’re putting all our horsepower behind one funky feline.

[h1]Announcement Trailer[/h1]
The Scratch The Cat announcement trailer had its world premiere as part of the [url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=adI4uizTYN4]Six One Indie Showcase[/url], alongside a behind-the-”screens” look at life inside FlatPonies barn. 

Wanna see Scratch’s moves? Now you can set your claws into the trailer: 

https://youtu.be/gB2HsYiWCfM
Scratch The Cat is available to wishlist now 👇

https://store.steampowered.com/app/858200/Scratch_The_Cat/

[h1]Meet Scratch[/h1]
In Scratch The Cat, you play as Scratch, a rhythm-driven DJ cat on a mission to recover his stolen records. The culprit? None other than Snatch the Rat and his gang of gnarly goons. With your paws on the decks, you’ll groove through vibrant worlds and face off against bosses in high-energy, beat-fueled battles.

[h2]What to expect:[/h2]
[list]
[*][b]Pure Platforming Vibes[/b] - A tribute to the golden age of 3D platformers, with a musical twist.
[*][b]Expressive Movement[/b] - Mix and chain together sick feline moves – run, jump, climb, swim, and dive your way through vibrant, colorful levels. And yes, you can fall from great heights (with cat-like grace, of course).
[*][b]Collect Record Fragments and Other Collectibles[/b] - Track down and recover Scratch’s irreplaceable record collection, one fragment at a time. Scattered across rhythm-infused worlds packed with puzzles, other collectibles, and quirky characters. 
[*][b]Face Off Against Unique Bosses[/b] - Go paw-to-paw with Snatch’s sneaky squad, where every boss fight is a stage - and you’re the headliner. Each boss encounter blends platforming mastery with rhythm-inspired mechanics, keeping you on your toes! Outsmart Snatch’s gang with style and flair.
[*][b]Explore a Musical World[/b] - Explore a world built from the beat up — where music doesn’t just set the tone – it shapes the visuals, the gameplay, and the flow of every level. From pulsing traffic lights to head-bobbing turtles, every corner of Scratch’s world moves to the rhythm.
[*][b]Customize Your Groove[/b] - Express yourself fuuuur real with a variety of customization options for Scratch’s look to personalize your journey.
[*][b]Original Soundtrack[/b] - Feel the beat as you play – with a signature soundtrack created specifically for the world of Scratch.
[/list]
We set out to create a platformer that feels like a mixtape: energetic, colorful, and full of surprises. Whether you're here for the tight controls or the catchy beats, we’re sure you’ll find something to love in Scratch’s world.

The game spun out from a student project made by Felix Sherar, our Creative Director: 

“The fact that I get to make my dream project — and that I have a skilled team working together toward that. The best part is when someone on the team has been working on something they're really excited to show me. That gets me really excited as well.”

[h1]About FlatPonies[/h1] 
FlatPonies is a Danish indie developer founded in 2017, known for #Archery, #SelfieTennis, #AkiRobots, and Rebots. Based in Copenhagen, we’re a talented herd of 3D-shaped humans trottin’ on forward with one goal: bringing rhythm and charm to your screen, one Scratch at a time.

Thanks for listening — and remember:
[b]Stay groovy. Stay scratchy.[/b]
With excitement and puuurfect hair,
FlatPonies
